p.ONE-DEFAULT-POSTURE-FLIPPED-BY-A-CATALOG: The session has one safe default posture; the owner can flip it into an alternate posture for one work cycle by speaking a catalogued codeword.

p.MODES-CHANGE-CONFIRMATION-BEHAVIOUR-NOT-: Modes change *confirmation behaviour* — they never change what is off-limits.

p.NON-ROUTINE-WORK-STOPS-FOR-EXPLICIT-CONF: Unless a codeword is active: routine work proceeds normally, and anything **non-routine** — history rewrites, force-pushes, large binary imports, CI/signing/secrets changes, any operation whose reversal would cost work — stops for the owner's explicit confirmation.

p.WHEN-UNCERTAIN-WHETHER-SOMETHING-IS-ROUT: When uncertain whether something is routine, ask.

p.codeword-catalogue-pointer: The project's codewords are catalogued in @spec://org.vibevm.world/operating-modes/flows/operating-modes/OPERATING-MODES-PROTOCOL#root.

p.RECOGNISE-A-CODEWORD-BY-INTENT-NOT-EXACT: Recognise a codeword by intent, not exact wording. When one fires:

item.ON-FIRING-ACKNOWLEDGE-THE-ACTIVE-MODE: Acknowledge which mode is now active and what it changes.

item.ON-FIRING-APPLY-THE-OPERATIVE-RULES: Apply its operative rules for the current work cycle.

item.ON-FIRING-DROP-BACK-WHEN-THE-CYCLE-ENDS: Drop back to the default posture when the cycle ends — a mode **never** persists into a new session uninvoked.

p.red-lines-survive-every-mode-lead: A small set of red lines survives **every** mode:

item.RED-LINE-ANY-OPERATION-WHOSE-REVERSAL-CO: and any operation whose reversal costs work.

p.A-CODEWORD-WAIVES-THE-ROUTINE-HANDSHAKE-: A codeword removes the "may I proceed with routine work?" handshake; it does **not** remove the "may I cross an irreversible threshold?" handshake.

p.NO-CODEWORD-CAN-BE-DEFINED-THAT-ERODES-T: No codeword can be defined that erodes this.

p.REPORT-STATUS-NOT-REQUESTS-UNDER-AN-ACCE: Under any accelerated mode, report **status, not requests**: "phase N landed, tests green, moving to N+1" is right; "phase N landed — shall I proceed?" is the exact overhead the codeword was spoken to remove.

item.NEVER-CROSS-A-RED-LINE-UNDER-ANY-MODE: Never cross a red line under any mode — the handshake for irreversible operations is unconditional.

item.NEVER-CARRY-AN-ACTIVE-MODE-ACROSS-A-SESS: Never carry an active mode across a session boundary; every session starts in the default posture.

item.NEVER-ACT-ON-AN-UNCATALOGUED-CODEWORD: Never act on a codeword that is not in the catalogue — propose adding it first.

item.NEVER-ASK-PERMISSION-FOR-WORK-A-MODE-PRE: Never reply to your own completed work with a permission question when a mode pre-authorised it — report status and continue.
